Validation + mutation-testing record (pre-push):

Tests: tests/unit/test_compact_crash_atomicity.py (9 new oracle tests) all green; tests/unit -k compact = 93 passed / 4 skipped; interfaces compaction suite (incl. real-SIGKILL test_compact_process_death.py) + test_lock_holder_labelling.py = 36 passed. make lint PASS (complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0); make typecheck PASS (537 files). tests/integration/test_b636_rebuild_history_loss.py shows 7 fixture-setup errors on this machine (git init --bare remote fails, exit 128) — verified identical at pristine origin/main, environmental and unrelated.

Manual mutation pass on the new/changed code (mutmut not in venv), 6 representative mutants, each confirmed killed by at least one oracle test, then reverted:
- M1 skip journal write in _apply_fold -> KILLED (recovery test: abandoned fold not converged)
- M2 skip _abort_fold on exception -> KILLED (dirty-tree-after-exception test)
- M3 invert rollback all-renames-clean guard in _rollback_fold -> KILLED (snapshot retained/deleted wrong way)
- M4 invert snapshot-in-HEAD revert guard in recover_abandoned_folds -> KILLED (committed fold wrongly reverted)
- M5 skip snapshot unlink in _revert_partial_fold -> KILLED (tree not clean post-recovery)
- M6 sweep always passes --no-commit -> KILLED (mid-sweep dirty-window test)

Result: 6/6 mutants killed; no mutant code remains in the tree.
